title: Biology · Paper 2 — original short and extended-response sample
subject: biology
paper: Paper 2 — original short and extended-response sample
instructions: Answer every question using the response area attached to it. An approved calculator is required; all data needed for this original sample is supplied within DigitalDP. Show calculations, units, diagrams and reasoning where required. No separate answer sheet is used.

resources.label: Original pond study
resources.text: Researchers added equal masses of leaf litter to eight pond tanks. Four tanks received extra nitrate. After 21 days, mean algal dry mass was 3.8 g without nitrate and 9.6 g with nitrate. Mean dissolved oxygen at dawn was 7.2 mg L⁻¹ without nitrate and 3.9 mg L⁻¹ with nitrate.

questions.label: Question 1 — data interpretation
questions.prompt: Calculate the percentage increase in mean algal dry mass caused by nitrate. Show the calculation and state the answer to three significant figures.

questions.label: Question 2 — causal model
questions.prompt: Construct an annotated causal diagram linking added nitrate to the change in dissolved oxygen at dawn.

questions.label: Question 3 — experimental design
questions.prompt: Design a follow-up investigation to test whether light intensity changes the effect of nitrate on algal growth. Include variables, controls, replication and the data to be collected.

questions.label: Question 4 — extended response
questions.prompt: Explain how membrane transport and cell respiration together maintain cellular conditions, using named examples.
